sources: The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder
description: ## Aberrant
‹SOURCE PRPG Core Rulebook/72›

There is a taint in your blood, one that is alien and bizarre. You tend to think in odd ways, approaching problems from an angle that most would not expect. Over time, this taint manifests itself in your physical form.
::cskill{gain=kd}

Aberrant sorcerers show increasing signs of their tainted heritage as they increase in level, although they are only visible when used.

abyssal.name: Abyssal
sources: The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder
description: ## Abyssal
‹SOURCE PRPG Core Rulebook/72›

Generations ago, a ‹family/demon› spread its filth into your heritage. While it does not manifest in all of your kin, for you it is particularly strong. You might sometimes have urges to chaos or evil, but your destiny (and alignment) is up to you.
::cskill{gain=kp}

::ab[Bonus Spells by Sorcerer Level]{icon=learn s3="Cause fear" s5="Bull's strength" s7=Rage s9=Stoneskin s11=Dismissal s13=Transformation s15="Greater teleport" s17="Unholy aura" s19="Summon monster IX"}
:::block{minimal hl}

::row{br="~" title="Bonus Feats" singleBreaks info="‹feat/Augment Summoning›~‹feat/Cleave›~‹feat/Empower Spell›~‹feat/Great Fortitude›~‹feat/Improved Bull Rush›~‹feat/Improved Sunder›~‹feat/Power Attack›~‹feat/Skill Focus› (Knowledge &#91&planes&#93&)"}
:::elephant
‹SOURCE The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder›

‹feat/Augment Summoning›, ‹feat/Cleave›, ‹feat/Empower Spell›, ‹feat/Great Fortitude›, ‹feat/Greater Bull Rush›, ‹feat/Greater Sunder›, @hll[rule/Powerful Maneuvers], ‹feat/Skill Focus› (Knowledge [planes])

::ab[Bloodline Arcana]{icon=def ability="Whenever you cast a spell of the ‹spelldef/summoning› subschool, the creatures summoned gain DR/good equal to half your sorcerer level (minimum 1). This does not stack with any DR the creature might have."}
### Bloodline Powers
While some would say that you are possessed, you know better. The demonic influence in your blood grows as you gain power.

::ab[Claws (Su)]{l=1 icon=melee free="You can grow claws. These claws are treated as ‹umr/natural weapons›, allowing you to make two claw attacks as a full attack action using your full base attack bonus. These attacks deal 1d4 points of damage each (1d3 if you are Small) plus your Strength modifier." imp5="These claws are considered magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming DR." imp7="The damage increases by one step to 1d6 points of damage (1d4 if you are Small)." imp11="These claws become ‹magic-enh/flaming› weapons, each dealing an additional 1d6 points of fire damage on a successful hit." useMod=Charisma3 useUnit=r useNC}

::ab[Demon Resistances (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def passive="You gain ‹umr/resist› electricity 5 and a +2 bonus on saving throws made against poison." imp9="Your resistance to electricity increases to 10 and your bonus on poison saving throws increases to +4."}
::ab[Strength of the Abyss (Ex)]{l=9 icon=boost passive="You gain a +2 inherent bonus to your Strength." increment="The bonus~9~4~4~2"}

::ab[Added Summonings (Su)]{l=15 icon=boost ability="Whenever you summon a creature with the ‹subtype/demon« subtype› or the ‹template/fiendish« template› using a *summon monster* spell, you summon one additional creature of the same kind."}

::ab[Demonic Might (Su)]{l=20 icon=def-power flavor="The power of the Abyss flows through you." passive="You gain immunity to electricity and poison and resistance to acid 10, cold 10, and fire 10." order=pa ability="You also gain ‹umr/telepathy› with a range of 60 feet (allowing you to communicate with any creature that can speak a language)."}
::h3[Brutal (Wildblooded Mutation)]{jl}
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/70›
The powers of the Abyss can vary radically, even for similar fiends.

::ab[Replacement Bloodline Arcana]{icon=boost ability="Whenever you cast a spell that deals hit point damage, one target of your choice affected by the spell takes 2 additional hit points of damage. This ability has no effect on spells that do not deal hit point damage (such as ability score damage)."}
### Bloodline Powers
Flight is often the key to survival.

::ab[Wings of the Abyss (Su)]{l=9 icon=power useL=sorcerer useUnit=m useNC=1 ability="You can sprout leathery wings and can fly with a speed of 60 feet and good maneuverability." replace="Strength of the abyss"}

accursed.name: Accursed
description: ## Accursed
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/66›

Misfortune, pestilence, and nightmares follow your family like vermin drawn to carrion. Somewhere in your family history, a ‹family/hag«'s› foul influence entered your bloodline. You may actually be related to the hag, or you may still be suffering the effects of a curse that a hag laid upon your kin in generations past. Now the hag's powers are part of your heritage.
::cskill{gain=per}

::ab[Bonus Spells by Sorcerer Level]{icon=learn s3="Ray of enfeeblement" s5="Touch of idiocy" s7="Ray of exhaustion" s9="Bestow curse" s11=Feeblemind s13=Eyebite s15=Insanity s17="Dimensional lock" s19="Energy drain"}
:::block{minimal hl}

::row{br="~" title="Bonus Feats" singleBreaks info="‹feat/Alertness›~‹feat/Blind-Fight›~‹feat/Combat Casting›~‹feat/Deceitful›~‹feat/Defensive Combat Training›~‹feat/Endurance›~‹feat/Great Fortitude›~‹feat/Mounted Combat›"}

::ab[Bloodline Arcana]{icon=power-boost order=pa passive="You count as a hag for the purpose of joining a hag's coven. The coven must contain at least one hag." ability="In addition, whenever you are within 30 feet of another sorcerer with this bloodline or a ‹class/witch› with the ‹hex/coven› hex, you can use the ‹rule/aid another<_2› action to grant a +1 bonus to the other spellcaster's caster level for 1 round."}
### Bloodline Powers
The source of your power isn't pretty, but it does allow you to emulate the preternatural ugliness and toughness of a hag - though doing so won't help you make friends.

::ab[Horrific Visage (Su)]{l=1 icon=select-lower flavor="You can draw upon your hag ancestor to cause one target to perceive you as having a horrifying appearance." standard="You can force one target within 30 feet to make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier) or be ‹misc/shaken› for a number of rounds equal to ‹misc/half› of your sorcerer level (minimum 1 round)." special="This is a mind-affecting, fear-based ability. This fear does not stack with other fear effects." useMod=Charisma3}
::ab[Wretched Endurance (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def passive="You gain a +2 bonus on all saving throws against charm, cold, fear, fire, and sleep effects." imp9="These bonuses increase to +4."}

::ab[Dread Gaze (Su)]{l=9 icon=select-lower flavor="You gain a form of the ‹monster/green hag«'s› *evil eye* power." standard="Once per day, you may fix your gaze on any one creature within 60 feet. The target must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier) or be ‹misc/staggered› for a number of rounds equal to half of your sorcerer level." imp17="You can use this ability twice per day." imp20="You may use this ability three times per day."}

::ab[Dream Walking (Sp)]{l=15 icon=magic ability="You can enter the ethereal plane. This functions like ‹spell/ethereal jaunt›, but with a duration of a number of minutes equal to ‹misc/half› of your sorcerer level. Once during this trip, you may cast ‹spell/nightmare› as a spell-like ability on a creature you see on the Material Plane. (This is an exception to the normal rule that ethereal creatures cannot affect targets on the Material Plane)."}
::ab[Fearsome Survival (Su)]{l=20 icon=def flavor="Your hag-blood gives you considerable resilience." passive="You gain DR 10/cold iron, and gain SR equal to 6 + your sorcerer level."}

aquatic.name: Aquatic
sources: The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder
description: ## Aquatic
‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/136›

Your family traces its heritage back to the ocean depths, whether scions of undersea empires left in the wake of nomadic sea-tribes, or the spawn of creeping ichthyic infiltrators into remote seaside villages. The song of the sea hums in your blood, calling the waves and all those within to your command.
::cskill{gain=swim}

::ab[Bonus Spells by Sorcerer Level]{icon=learn s3="Hydraulic push" s5=Slipstream s7="Aqueous orb" s9=Geyser s11="Control water" s13="Beast shape IV" s15="Summon monster VII" s17=Seamantle s19="World wave"}
:::block{minimal hl}

::row{br="~" title="Bonus Feats" singleBreaks info="‹feat/Athletic›~‹feat/Brew Potion›~‹feat/Defensive Combat Training›~‹feat/Dodge›~‹feat/Mobility›~‹feat/Silent Spell›~‹feat/Skill Focus› (Swim)~‹feat/Toughness›"}
:::elephant
‹SOURCE The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder›
‹feat/Athletic›, ‹feat/Brew Potion›, ‹feat/Defensive Combat Training›, ‹feat/Dodge›, ‹feat/Silent Spell›, ‹feat/Skill Focus› (Swim), ‹feat/Spring Attack›, ‹feat/Toughness›

::ab[Bloodline Arcana]{icon=boost ability="Whenever you cast a spell of the water type, your effective caster level is increased by one, and summoned creatures with a swim speed or the aquatic or water type gain a +1 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls."}
### Bloodline Powers
Your seaborn magical talents awaken changes in you, both mystical and physical, as you develop your powers.

::ab[Dehydrating Touch (Sp)]{l=1 icon=touch standard="You can make a melee touch attack that inflicts nonlethal damage equal to 1d6 + ‹misc/half› of your sorcerer level and sickens the target for 1 round. Oozes, plants, and creatures with the aquatic or water subtypes suffer lethal damage instead." useMod=Charisma3}

::ab[Aquatic Adaptation (Ex)]{l=3 icon=power-def ability="You gain a swim speed of 30 feet." imp9="You gain the ‹umr/amphibious› special quality and develop a fat layer that grants a +1 natural armor bonus and ‹umr/resist› cold 5. When immersed in water, you gain ‹umr/blindsense› 30 feet." imp15="You gain a swim speed of 60 feet and blindsense of 60 feet in water."}

::ab[Aquatic Telepathy (Su)]{l=9 icon=power-magic ability="You gain ‹umr/telepathy› (100 feet) and can communicate with creatures with a swim speed or the aquatic or water types regardless of intelligence. You may cast ‹spell/suggestion› on such creatures a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier. This ability is telepathic and does not require audible or visual components." imp15="Once per day you can telepathically call and request a service from an aquatic, water, or swimming creature as if using ‹spell/demand› or ‹spell/greater planar ally›."}

::ab[Raise the Deep (Sp)]{l=15 icon=magic ability="Once per day, you can raise water as per *control water,* but no water need be present. This created water is stationary and does not flow out of the area where you create it; it lasts 1 round per sorcerer level and then disappears." imp20="The dimensions of the effect are doubled."}

::ab[Deep One (Ex)]{l=20 icon=power-def ability="You gain blindsense 60 feet and your body is covered with fine, slippery scales granting DR 10/piercing, resist cold 20, and continuous ‹spell/freedom of movement›.~~~Underwater, you gain evasion and ‹umr/blindsight› 120 feet, and you are immune to ‹rule/pressure damage› from deep water."}
::h3[Seaborn (Wildblooded Mutation)]{jl}
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/72›
Your powers rise like the tides.
::ab[Replacement Bloodline Arcana]{icon=boost passive="When you are in a body of water large enough to float in, your effective caster level is increased by 1."}
### Bloodline Powers
You prefer to attack with water rather than to leech it away.

::ab[Water Blast (Sp)]{l=1 icon=zap standard="You can fire a bolt of water at a foe within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack. The foe is knocked ‹rule/prone›, and at your option may be pushed 5 feet directly away from you. A reflex save (DC 10 +1/2 your sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier) negates this effect." useMod=Charisma3 replace="Dehydrating touch"}

arcane.name: Arcane
description: ## Arcane
‹SOURCE PRPG Core Rulebook/73›
Your family has always been skilled in the eldritch art of magic. While many of your relatives were accomplished wizards, your powers developed without the need for study and practice.
::cskill{gain=ka}

::ab[Bonus Spells by Sorcerer Level]{icon=learn s3=Identify s5=Invisibility s7="Dispel magic" s9="Dimension door" s11="Overland flight" s13="True seeing" s15="Greater teleport" s17="Power word stun" s19=Wish}
:::block{minimal hl}

::row{br="~" title="Bonus Feats" singleBreaks info="‹feat/Combat Casting›~‹feat/Improved Counterspell›~‹feat/Improved Initiative›~‹feat/Iron Will›~‹feat/Scribe Scroll›~‹feat/Skill Focus› (Knowledge &#91&arcana&#93&)~‹feat/Spell Focus›~‹feat/Still Spell›"}

::ab[Bloodline Arcana]{icon=boost ability="Whenever you apply a metamagic feat to a spell that increases the slot used by at least one level, increase the spell's DC by +1. This bonus does not stack with itself and does not apply to spells modified by the ‹feat/Heighten Spell› feat."}
### Bloodline Powers
Magic comes naturally to you, but as you gain levels you must take care to prevent the power from overwhelming you.

::ab[Arcane Bond (Su)]{l=1 icon=power order=a2 ability="You gain an *arcane bond,* as a ‹class/wizard› equal to your sorcerer level. Your sorcerer levels stack with any wizard levels you possess when determining the powers of your familiar or bonded object. This ability does not allow you to have both a familiar and a bonded item." ability2="Once per day, your *bonded item* allows you to cast any one of your spells known (unlike a wizard's bonded item, which allows him to cast any one spell in his spellbook)."}

::ab[Metamagic Adept (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost ability="You can apply any one ‹main/metamagic feat› you know to a spell you are about to cast without increasing the casting time. You must still expend a higher-level spell slot to cast this spell." useInc=sorcerer~4~3 useF="3~1~4" imp20="This ability is replaced by *arcane apotheosis* (see below)."}

::ab[New Arcana (Ex)]{l=9 icon=learn ability="You can add any one spell from the ‹main/spells_>sorcerer›/‹main/spells_>wizard› spell list to your list of spells known. This spell must be of a level that you are capable of casting." repeat="You can add one additional spell.~13~4"}

::ab[School Power (Ex)]{l=15 icon=boost ability="Pick one school of magic. The DC for any spells you cast from that school increases by +2. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by ‹feat/Spell Focus›."}

::ab[Arcane Apotheosis (Ex)]{l=20 icon=boost-power order=a2 flavor="Your body surges with arcane power." ability="You can add any metamagic feats that you know to your spells without increasing their casting time, although you must still expend higher-level spell slots." ability2="Whenever you use magic items that require charges, you can instead expend spell slots to power the item. For every three levels of spell slots that you expend, you consume one less charge when using a magic item that expends charges."}
::h3[Sage (Wildblooded Mutation)]{jl}
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/72›
Scholars of the arcane are always creating new means to use magic.

::ab[Replacement Bloodline Arcana]{icon=boost order=ap flavor="Unlike most sorcerers, whose innate magic is powered by force of personality, you use your intellect to understand and master your mystic powers." ability="You use your Intelligence, rather than your Charisma, to determine all class features and effects relating to your sorcerer class, such as bonus spells per day, the maximum spell level you can cast, the save DCs of your spells, and the number of daily uses of your bloodline powers." passive="You gain a +2 bonus on all Knowledge (arcana) and Spellcraft checks."}
### Bloodline Powers
Your preferred focus is a bolt of mind-spun magic.

::ab[Arcane Bolt (Sp)]{l=1 icon=zap standard="You can unleash a ray of magic force, targeting any foe within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack. This ray deals an amount of damage equal to 1d4 + ‹misc/half› of your sorcerer level. This damage is treated as a spell of a level equal to half your sorcerer level, and is a force effect." useMod=Charisma3 replace="Arcane bond"}

astral.name: Astral
sources: The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder
description: ## Astral
‹SOURCE Distant Realms/62›

Whether you were raised on the Astral Plane, had an ancestor with a strong connection to the Astral, or simply had a freak brush with an astral conduit in your youth, you have an unusual connection to both time and space. Your senses extend through the ‹rule/Astral Plane› to the far reaches of the multiverse, allowing you to perceive and manipulate the timeless potential that binds the multiverse together. Your ancestors may have also held a connection to one of the astral isles or conduits, or like you, may have plied this cosmic ocean - and some may even survive there to this day.
::cskill{gain=kp}

::ab[Bonus Spells by Sorcerer Level]{icon=learn s3="True strike" s5="False life" s7="Sands of time" s9="Wandering star motes" s11=Permanency s13=Contingency s15="Ethereal jaunt" s17="Create demiplane" s19="Time stop"}
:::block{minimal hl}

::row{br="~" title="Bonus Feats" singleBreaks info="‹feat/Combat Reflexes›~‹feat/Dodge›~‹feat/Forge Ring›~‹feat/Improved Initiative›~‹feat/Lightning Reflexes›~‹feat/Quicken Spell›~‹feat/Skill Focus› (Knowledge &#91&planes&#93&)~‹feat/Weapon Finesse›"}
:::elephant
‹SOURCE The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder›

@hll[feat/Agile Combatant], ‹feat/Combat Reflexes›, ‹feat/Dodge›, ‹feat/Forge Ring›, ‹feat/Improved Initiative›, ‹feat/Lightning Reflexes›, ‹feat/Quicken Spell›, ‹feat/Skill Focus› (Knowledge [planes])

::ab[Bloodline Arcana]{icon=boost ability="When you cast a spell, you can choose to enhance the next spell you cast before the end of your next turn, increasing the enhanced spell's saving throw DC by 1. The level of the enhanced spell must be lower than that of the spell used to activate this ability."}
### Bloodline Powers
You can warp time and project your senses into the Astral Plane.

::ab[Astral Warp (Sp)]{l=1 icon=select ability="You can create a sparkling field within 30 feet that distorts time within a 5-foot cube. This field lasts until the beginning of your next turn. Any creature that enters the area or that starts its turn within the cube takes an amount of force damage equal to 1d4 + ‹misc/half› of your sorcerer level (Fortitude negates). While within the area, a creature takes a -1 penalty on Reflex saves and to AC." useMod=Charisma3}

::ab[Peerless Speed (Su)]{l=3 icon=boost flavor="You can tap into the power of the Astral's enhanced magical nature to gain the ability to accelerate your spellcasting dramatically." swift="Once per day, you can cast one cantrip you know as though it were augmented by the Quicken Spell metamagic feat, without altering the cantrip's level." incrementPlain="The maximum level of the spell you can augment~3~2~1" special="If you use this ability while on the Asgtral Plane or on any plane whose ‹rule/enhanced »magic trait<s› allows you to cast a spell as if augmented by Quicken Spell, you can instead choose to augment the spell as though you had applied the ‹feat/Empower Spell› or ‹feat/Maximize Spell› metamagic feats instead."}

::ab[Astral Voyager (Sp)]{l=9 icon=magic ability="You can send your consciousness to the Astral Plane once per day. This functions as ‹spell/lesser astral projection› and allows you to bring with you up to a number of additional willing creature equal to ‹misc/half› of your sorcerer level." imp13="You can cast ‹spell/plane shift› once per day, but only on yourself and willing targets that accompany you, and only from the Material Plane to the Astral Plane and vice versa." imp17="This ability instead functions as ‹spell/astral projection›."}

::ab[Arrest the Flow (Su)]{l=15 icon=def-boost immediate="Once per day, you can attune yourself to the Astral's timeless nature to halt the effects of one condition or affliction (such as ‹rule/paralyzed›, ‹misc/stunned›, a poison, or a curse), including permanent and instantaneous conditions, until the end of your next turn. You can use this ability even when a condition or affliction would normally prevent you from doing so, regardless of whether you're targeting that prevention effect's source.~~~At the end of your next turn the condition or affliction resumes its normal effect and the round delayed by this ability does not count toward the condition or affliction's duration. This ability has no effect on hit point damage, ability damage, or the dead condition.~~~Alternatively, you can use this ability to extend the duration of any one effect affecting you until the end of your next turn; this does not extend the duration for any other creatures under the effect." imp19="You can use this ability twice per day."}

::ab[Timeless Soul (Ex)]{l=20 icon=def-boost order=pa flavor="The silver skies and conduits of the Astral Plane are permanently connected to you." passive="You become immune to the retroactive aging side effects incurred when leaving a plane with the ‹rule/time«less planar» trait<s›. You do not gain negative levels when slain on the Astral Plane while using *astral projection,* and any effect that would sever your silver cord instead returns you to your physical body if you succeed at a Will save (DC = 10 + the CR of the creature or caster level of the effect that severed the cord)." ability="In addition, when applying the ‹feat/Quicken Spell› metamagic feat to a spell, it uses up a spell slot only 3 levels higher than the spell's actual level. This ability does not stack with other abilities that would reduce the spell's final adjusted level."}

boreal.name: Boreal
sources: The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder
description: ## Boreal
‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/136›

Descended from inhabitants of the lands of ice and snow, you count among your ancestors giant-kin, troll-born, and frost-rimed spirits. Their savage and raw energies flow down through generations to infuse you to the marrow with the chill of the polar wind, crackling auroras, and the long winter's night.
::cskill{gain=sur}

::ab[Bonus Spells by Sorcerer Level]{icon=learn s3="Enlarge person" s5=Rage s7="Elemental aura|(cold only)" s9="Wall of ice" s11="Cone of cold" s13=Transformation s15="Giant form I" s17="Polar ray" s19="Meteor swarm|(dealing cold damage)"}
:::block{minimal hl}

::row{br="~" title="Bonus Feats" singleBreaks info="‹feat/Arcane Strike›~‹feat/Diehard›~‹feat/Empower Spell›~‹feat/Endurance›~‹feat/Exotic Weapon Proficiency›~‹feat/Power Attack›~‹feat/Skill Focus› (Intimidate)~‹feat/Toughness›"}
:::elephant
‹SOURCE The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder›
‹feat/Arcane Strike›, ‹feat/Diehard›, ‹feat/Empower Spell›, ‹feat/Endurance›, ‹feat/Exotic Weapon Proficiency›, @hll[rule/Powerful Maneuvers], ‹feat/Skill Focus› (Intimidate), ‹feat/Toughness›
::ab[Bloodline Arcana]{icon=boost ability="Whenever you cast a spell with the cold descriptor, increase the spell's save DC by 1."}
### Bloodline Powers
Your connection to primeval winters grants you a mastery of cold magic that few can match, and a savagery that fewer still can withstand.

::ab[Cold Steel (Sp)]{l=1 icon=boost standard="You can touch a weapon or up to 50 pieces of ammunition, giving it the ‹magic-enh/frost› property for a number of rounds equal to ‹misc/half› your sorcerer level (minimum 1)." imp9="You can confer the ‹magic-enh/icy burst› property instead, but the duration of the power is halved." useMod=Charisma3}

::ab[Icewalker (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def-power ability="You gain ‹umr/resist› cold 5 and can move across snow and icy surfaces without penalty and without leaving tracks." imp9="You gain resist cold 10 and can climb icy surfaces as if using ‹spell/spider climb›."}

::ab[Snow Shroud (Su)]{l=9 icon=boost-def passive="You ignore ‹rule/concealment› and ‹skill/Perception› penalties in natural or magical snow, ice, fog, and similar weather conditions." order=pa ability="Once per day, you can surround yourself with a cloak of swirling snow for a number of rounds per day equal to your sorcerer level. This power acts and deals damage as a ‹spell/fire shield› (chill shield) that sheds no light. It provides a 20% miss chance on attacks made against you and grants a bonus on ‹skill/Stealth› checks equal to half your sorcerer level in snowy or icy areas." imp17="You can use this ability twice per day." imp20="You can use this ability three times per day."}

::ab[Blizzard (Sp)]{l=15 icon=magic-aura flavor="You can create a savage winter storm centered on you." ability="This power acts as ‹spell/control winds›, but in addition the entire area (not including the &quot&eye&quot& at the center of the storm) is affected as a ‹spell/sleet storm› and all in the area are exposed to extreme cold." usage="Once per day"}

::ab[Child of Ancient Winters (Su)]{l=20 icon=power-def-down passive="You gain the ‹subtype/cold› subtype and you become immune to fatigue and exhaustion. In addition, you gain immunity to sneak attacks and critical hits. This power causes you to gain vulnerability to fire."}
::h3[Rime-Blooded (Wildblooded Mutation)]{jl}
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/72›
The wintry origin of your magic flows like ice water in your veins.

::ab[Replacement Bloodline Arcana]{icon=select-lower ability="Whenever you cast a spell with the cold descriptor, you may select one target of the spell to be ‹spell/slow«ed› (as the spell) for 1 round. A Fortitude save (DC 10 + the level of cold spell + your Charisma modifier) negates the effect."}
### Bloodline Powers
Sometimes you must bring the cold to your enemies.

::ab[Freezing Bolt (Sp)]{l=9 icon=boom ability="Once per day, you can cause the air to erupt in freezing sleet. This 10-foot-radius ‹misc/burst› does 1d6 points of cold damage per sorcerer level (Reflex half). The DC of this save is equal to 10 + 1/2 your sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier. This power has a range of 60 feet." imp17="You can use this ability twice per day." imp20="You can use this ability three times per day." replace="Snow shroud"}

celestial.name: Celestial
sources: The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder
description: ## Celestial
‹SOURCE PRPG Core Rulebook/74›

Your bloodline is blessed by a celestial power, either from a celestial ancestor or through divine intervention. Although this power drives you along the path of good, your fate (and alignment) is your own to determine.
::cskill{gain=heal}

::ab[Bonus Spells by Sorcerer Level]{icon=learn s3=Bless s5="Resist energy" s7="Magic circle against evil" s9="Remove curse" s11="Flame strike" s13="Greater dispel magic" s15=Banishment s17=Sunburst s19=Gate}
:::block{minimal hl}

::row{br="~" title="Bonus Feats" singleBreaks info="‹feat/Dodge›~‹feat/Extend Spell›~‹feat/Iron Will›~‹feat/Mobility›~‹feat/Mounted Combat›~‹feat/Ride-By Attack›~‹feat/Skill Focus› (Knowledge &#91&religion&#93&)~‹feat/Weapon Finesse›"}
:::elephant
‹SOURCE The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder›
@hll[feat/Agile Combatant], ‹feat/Dodge›, ‹feat/Extend Spell›, ‹feat/Iron Will›, ‹feat/Mounted Combat›, ‹feat/Ride-By Attack›, ‹feat/Skill Focus› (Knowledge [religion]), ‹feat/Spring Attack›

::ab[Bloodline Arcana]{icon=def ability="Whenever you cast a spell of the ‹spelldef/summoning› subschool, the creatures summoned gain DR/evil equal to 1/2 your sorcerer level (minimum 1). This does not stack with any DR the creature might have."}
### Bloodline Powers
Your celestial heritage grants you a great many powers, but they come at a price. The lords of the higher planes are watching you and your actions closely.

::ab[Heavenly Fire (Sp)]{l=1 icon=zap standard="You can unleash a ray of heavenly fire, targeting any foe within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack. Against evil creatures, this ray deals an amount of damage equal to 1d4 + ‹misc/half› of your sorcerer level. This damage is divine and not subject to energy resistance or immunity.~~~This ray heals good creatures of an amount of damage equal to 1d4 + half of your sorcerer level. A good creature cannot benefit from your heavenly fire more than once per day.~~~Neutral creatures are neither harmed nor healed by this effect." useMod=Charisma3}
::ab[Celestial Resistances (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def passive="You gain ‹umr/resist› acid 5 and resist cold 5." imp9="Your resistances increase to 10."}
::ab[Wings of Heaven (Su)]{l=9 icon=power ability="You can sprout feathery wings and fly with a speed of 60 feet and good maneuverability." useL=sorcerer useUnit=m useNC=1}

::ab[Conviction (Su)]{l=15 icon=roll ability="You can reroll any one ability check, attack roll, skill check, or saving throw you just made. You must decide to use this ability after the die is rolled, but before the results are revealed by the GM. You must take the second result, even if it is worse. You can use this ability once per day."}

::ab[Ascension (Su)]{l=20 order=pa icon=def-boost-power flavor="You become infused with the power of the heavens." passive="You gain immunity to acid, cold, and petrification. You also gain resist electricity 10, resist fire 10, and a +4 racial bonus on saves against poison." ability="You gain unlimited use of the *wings of heaven* ability. You also gain the ability to speak with any creature that has a language (as per the ‹spell/tongues› spell)."}
::h3[Empyreal (Wildblooded Mutation)]{jl}
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/71›
Your heavenly power derives from insight rather than force of personality.

::ab[Replacement Bloodline Arcana]{icon=boost flavor="Unlike most sorcerers whose innate magic is powered by force of personality, you use pure willpower to master and fuel your magic." info="You use your Wisdom, rather than your Charisma, to determine all class features and effects relating to your sorcerer class, such as bonus spells per day, maximum spell level you can cast, and the save DCs of your spells." order=np passive="You gain a +2 bonus on all Heal and Knowledge (religion) checks."}
### Bloodline Powers
Your quasi-divine nature gives you strange powers.

::ab[Sacred Cistern (Su)]{l=9 icon=power-aura flavor="Your bloodline makes you a natural receptacle of divine energy." ability="You can ‹ability/channel energy› once per day as a cleric of your sorcerer level - 4." replace="Wings of heaven"}

daemon.name: Daemon
description: ## Daemon
‹SOURCE Blood of Fiends/29›

A ‹family/daemon› lurks somewhere along your family tree. Your powers derive from these soul-devouring fiends, who take pleasure and gain power from manipulating mortal frailties like aging, pestilence, famine, and the horrors of war. Your lineage gives you great insight into how to exploit the weaknesses of living beings and how to use leeched soul energy to enhance your wicked abilities.
::cskill{gain=heal}

::ab[Bonus Spells by Sorcerer Level]{icon=learn s3="Ray of enfeeblement" s5="Touch of idiocy" s7="Vampiric touch" s9=Contagion s11=Blight s13="Circle of death" s15="Waves of exhaustion" s17="Horrid wilting" s19="Soul bind"}
:::block{minimal hl}

::row{br="~" title="Bonus Feats" singleBreaks info="‹feat/Diehard›~‹feat/Endurance›~‹feat/Fast Healer›~‹feat/Great Fortitude›~‹feat/Heroic Defiance›~‹feat/Heroic Recovery›~‹feat/Sickening Spell›~‹feat/Toughness›"}

::ab[Bloodline Arcana]{icon=boost passive="Whenever you cast a spell that kills one or more living creatures with an Intelligence score of 3 or higher, the caster level of any spell you cast in the next round increases by +1 for each creature your first spell killed." special="This ability does not stack with other effects that increase your effective caster level, and you cannot gain a bonus greater than 1/2 your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). The second spell you cast must be of an equal or lower level than the first one."}
### Bloodline Powers
Like that of a daemon, your magic derives from painful and lingering death.

::ab[Wasting Ray (Sp)]{l=1 icon=select-lower standard="You can impose either starvation or thirst upon a living creature you can see within 30 feet. This requires the creature to make a Constitution check each round (DC 10 + 1 for each previous check) to avoid taking 1d6 points of nonlethal damage. The creature must continue to make these checks until, as a @HLfull-round_action, it quenches its thirst or sates its hunger." useMod=Charisma3 special="You can only apply this ability once every 24 hours to any given creature. Creatures that do not need to eat are immune to this effect."}

::ab[Daemonic Resistances (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def passive="You gain ‹umr/resist› acid 5 and a +2 bonus on saving throws made against poison and death effects." imp9="Your resistance to acid increases to 10 and your bonus on saving throws against poison and death effects increases to +4."}

::ab[Age Out (Su)]{l=9 icon=def-down flavor="You gain the ability to instantly recover from most harmful effects by temporarily aging yourself decades in a matter of moments." standard="You can shift your effective age to the next highest aging step (for example, from adulthood to middle age). Each time you do this, any debilitating condition or effect currently affecting you that initially allowed a Will or Fortitude saving throw immediately ends." special="When you age yourself in this way, you take the ‹rule/age>«normal penalties associated with growing older› but gain none of the benefits. You cannot use this power to age beyond venerable, recover hit point damage, or remove effects that did not or do not allow a Will or Fortitude saving throw to negate. You return to your actual age 24 hours after the last time you used this ability, and all penalties to ability scores as a result of advanced age are then removed."}

::ab[Wound Warp (Sp)]{l=15 icon=magic-aura flavor="You gain the ability to travel across the battlefield by literally erupting from the fatal wounds of deceased creatures." standard="Once per day, you can teleport to an unoccupied square adjacent to any dead creature within 10 feet per caster level. Any creatures adjacent to the square you teleport to take 4d6 points of acid damage as you burst into being and shower them with acidic bile. Creatures that make successful Reflex saves (DC 10 + 1/2 your sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier) take half damage. This ability otherwise functions like ‹spell/dimension door›." imp20="You can use this ability twice per day."}

::ab[One with Abaddon (Su)]{l=20 icon=def flavor="Your body embraces the unspeakable power of your daemon lineage." passive="You gain immunity to acid, death effects, and poison. You also gain DR 5/good or silver and resistance to cold 10, electricity 10, and fire 10."}

deep_earth.name: Deep Earth
description: ## Deep Earth
‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/137›

The echoing cave-songs and the rumble and creak of primal spirits deep below the ground thrum in your soul and in all your family line. You are likely slow, steady, and stable in your thinking, little prone to wandering and preferring to instead find depth in contemplation.
::cskill{gain=kd}

::ab[Bonus Spells by Sorcerer Level]{icon=learn s3="Expeditious excavation" s5=Darkvision s7="Shifting sand" s9=Stoneskin s11="Spike stones" s13="Stone tell" s15="Repel metal or stone" s17=Earthquake s19="Clashing rocks"}
:::block{minimal hl}

::row{br="~" title="Bonus Feats" singleBreaks info="‹feat/Acrobatic Steps›~‹feat/Alertness›~‹feat/Blind-Fight›~‹feat/Forge Ring›~‹feat/Nimble Moves›~‹feat/Skill Focus› (Perception)~‹feat/Stealthy›~‹feat/Still Spell›"}
::ab[Bloodline Arcana]{icon=boost passive="Whenever you and the target of your spell are both underground, increase the spell's save DC by +1."}
### Bloodline Powers
The powers of the living rock are within you, and your communion with the strength of stone is refined and enhanced as your power grows.

::ab[Tremor (Sp)]{l=1 icon=select standard="You can cause the ground to shake beneath a single creature within 30 feet, functioning as a ‹rule/trip› maneuver using your sorcerer level plus your Charisma modifier in place of your CMB." useMod=Charisma3}

::ab[Rockseer (Su)]{l=3 icon=power-boost ability="You gain the stonecunning trait as a ‹race/dwarf›; if already a dwarf, your bonus improves to +4." imp9="You gain ‹umr/tremorsense› 30 feet." imp15="You can see through solid objects as if using a ‹magic-ring/ring of x-ray vision› for a number of rounds per day equal to your sorcerer level. These rounds do not need to be consecutive."}

::ab[Crystal Shard (Sp)]{l=9 icon=boost standard="Once per day, you can touch a metal or stone weapon (or up to 50 pieces of ammunition), giving it the ‹magic-enh/bane› property against any creature with the earth subtype, oozes, or constructs made of stone or metal, for 1 minute." imp17="You can use this ability twice per day." imp20="You can use this ability three times a day."}

::ab[Earth Glide (Ex)]{l=15 icon=power ability="You can glide through any sort of natural earth or stone as easily as a fish swims through water, with a burrow speed equal to half your normal speed. You do not leave a tunnel or trace of your passage." useL=sorcerer useUnit=m useNC=1}

::ab[Strength of Stone (Su)]{l=20 icon=def passive="Your flesh becomes as hard as stone, giving you DR 10/adamantine, and you become immune to petrification. You suffer no penalties while squeezing through tight spaces and are immune to bull rush, drag, grapple, reposition, and trip maneuvers, and to ‹umr/push› and ‹umr/pull› effects as long as you are standing on the ground."}
::h3[Bedrock (Wildblooded Mutation)]{jl}
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/70›
Your earth magic is more defensive than offensive.

::ab[Replacement Bloodline Arcana]{icon=def passive="Whenever you cast a spell of the summoning subschool, the creatures summoned gain DR/adamantine equal to 1/2 your sorcerer level (minimum 1). This does not stack with any DR the creature might have."}
### Bloodline Powers
Rock is timeless; it endures.
::ab[Iron Hide (Sp)]{l=9 icon=def swift="You can grant yourself DR 10/adamantine." replace="Crystal shard" useL=sorcerer useUnit=r useNC}

destined.name: Destined
description: ## Destined
‹SOURCE PRPG Core Rulebook/74›

Your family is destined for greatness in some way. Your birth could have been foretold in prophecy, or perhaps it occurred during an especially auspicious event, such as a solar eclipse. Regardless of your bloodline's origin, you have a great future ahead.
::cskill{gain=kh}

::ab[Bonus Spells by Sorcerer Level]{icon=learn s3=Alarm s5=Blur s7="Protection from energy" s9="Freedom of movement" s11="Break enchantment" s13=Mislead s15="Spell turning" s17="Moment of prescience" s19=Foresight}
:::block{minimal hl}

::row{br="~" title="Bonus Feats" singleBreaks info="‹feat/Arcane Strike›~‹feat/Diehard›~‹feat/Endurance›~‹feat/Leadership›~‹feat/Lightning Reflexes›~‹feat/Maximize Spell›~‹feat/Skill Focus› (Knowledge &#91&history&#93&)~‹feat/Weapon Focus›"}
::ab[Bloodline Arcana]{icon=def passive="Whenever you cast a spell with a range of &quot&personal,&quot& you gain a luck bonus equal to the spell's level on all your saving throws for 1 round."}
### Bloodline Powers
You are destined for great things, and the powers that you gain serve to protect you.

::ab[Touch of Destiny (Sp)]{l=1 icon=boost-protect standard="You can touch a creature, giving it an insight bonus on attack rolls, skill checks, ability checks, and saving throws equal to 1/2 your sorcerer level (minimum 1) for 1 round." useMod=Charisma3}

::ab[Fated (Su)]{l=3 icon=def passive="You gain a +1 luck bonus on all of your saving throws and to your AC during surprise rounds and when you are otherwise unaware of an attack." increment="This bonus~3~4"}

::ab[It Was Meant To Be (Su)]{l=9 icon=roll ability="Once per day, you may reroll any one attack roll, critical hit confirmation roll, or level check made to overcome spell resistance. You must decide to use this ability after the first roll is made but before the results are revealed by the GM. You must take the second result, even if it is worse." imp17="You can use this ability twice per day."}

::ab[Within Reach (Su)]{l=15 icon=def flavor="Your ultimate destiny is drawing near." ability="Once per day, when an attack or spell that causes damage would result in your death, you may attempt a DC 20 Will save. If successful, you are instead reduced to -1 hit points and are automatically ‹misc/stabilize«d›. The bonus from your *fated* ability applies to this save."}

::ab[Destiny Realized (Su)]{l=20 icon=def-boost flavor="Your moment of destiny is at hand." order=pa passive="Any critical threats made against you only confirm if the second roll results in a natural 20 on the die. Any critical threats you score with a spell are automatically confirmed." ability="Once per day, you can automatically succeed at one caster level check made to overcome spell resistance. You must use this ability before making the roll."}
::h3[Karmic (Wildblooded Mutation)]{jl}
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/71›
The universe punishes those who interfere with destiny.

::ab[Replacement Bloodline Arcana]{icon=lower passive="If you are casting defensively because a creature is threatening you and you fail your ‹rule/concentration› check, one of the creatures that is threatening you provokes an attack of opportunity from you or from one ally who is adjacent to the enemy. You decide which creature provokes this attack and which of its adjacent opponents may make the attack."}
### Bloodline Powers
Your blood responds angrily when you are attacked.

::ab[Fate's Retribution (Su)]{l=1 icon=lower immediate="When you are hit by a melee attack you can curse the creature that struck you. The target takes a -2 penalty on all attack and damage rolls for 1d4 rounds. A Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier) negates this effect." useMod=Charisma3 replace="Touch of destiny"}

div.name: Div
sources: The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder
description: ## Div
‹SOURCE People of the Sands/23›
You can trace your ancestry to one of the foul, corrupted genies known as ‹family/div«s›.
::cskill{gain=kp}

::ab[Bonus Spells by Sorcerer Level]{icon=learn s3="Disguise self" s5="Touch of idiocy" s7="Deeper darkness" s9="Bestow curse" s11="Insect plague" s13=Disintegrate s15=Insanity s17=Earthquake s19=Wish}
:::block{minimal hl}

::row{br="~" title="Bonus Feats" singleBreaks info="‹feat/Blind-Fight›~‹feat/Deceitful›~‹feat/Empower Spell›~‹feat/Improved Initiative›~‹feat/Iron Will›~‹feat/Lightning Reflexes›~‹feat/Persuasive›~‹feat/Power Attack›"}
:::elephant

‹feat/Blind-Fight›, ‹feat/Deceitful›, ‹feat/Empower Spell›, ‹feat/Improved Initiative›, ‹feat/Iron Will›, ‹feat/Lightning Reflexes›, ‹feat/Persuasive›, @hll[rule/Powerful Maneuvers]
::ab[Bloodline Arcana]{icon=boost passive="Whenever you deal damage to more than one creature with a spell that affects an area, the save DCs of your spells increase by 1 for 1d4 rounds."}
### Bloodline Powers
The corrupt blood within you grants you powers to devastate the works and bonds of mortals.

::ab[Spoiling Touch (Su)]{l=1 icon=touch ability="You can impose the ‹misc/broken› condition upon one Medium or smaller object by making a successful melee touch attack. Magical items or objects carried or worn by a creature are allowed a Fortitude save to resist this effect. Multiple uses of this effect do not stack." useMod=Charisma3}

::ab[Div Resistances (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def passive="You gain fire ‹umr/resistance› 5 and a +2 bonus on saving throws against poison." imp9="Your resistance to fire increases to 10 and your bonus on saving throws against poison increases to +4."}

::ab[Corrupting Aura (Ex)]{l=9 icon=aura-lower ability="Once per day, you can surround yourself with an aura of corrupting energy for a number of rounds per day equal to your sorcerer level. Any creature within 10 feet of you takes nonlethal damage equal to 1d6 + ‹misc/half› of your sorcerer level, and it is ‹misc/sickened› for 1 round. In addition, any creature within the aura that attempts casting a divine spell must succeed at a caster level check (DC 15 + double the level of the spell) or lose the spell." imp17="You can use this ability twice per day." imp20="You can use this ability three times a day."}

::ab[Squander (Su)]{l=15 icon=select-lower flavor="You gain the ability to force others to waste the opportunities they are given." standard="Once per day, you can cause a target within 30 feet to gain the ‹misc/staggered› condition for a number of rounds equal to your sorcerer level. The duration is halved if the target makes a successful Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your sorcerer level + your Cha modifier)."}

::ab[Ahriman's Favor (Su)]{l=20 icon=def-power flavor="You are filled with ‹monster/Ahriman«'s› wickedness." ability="You gain immunity to fire and poison. You also gain acid resistance 10 and electricity resistance 10, and the ability to see perfectly in darkness of any kind to a range of 60 feet."}

djinni.name: Djinni
sources: The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder
description: ## Djinni
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/66›
You were born with the power of air genies, and the magic of the ‹monster/djinn<i› is strong in you.
::cskill{gain=kp}

::ab[Bonus Spells by Sorcerer Level]{icon=learn s3="Shocking grasp" s5=Invisibility s7=Fly s9="Minor creation" s11="Overland flight" s13="Chain lightning" s15="Plane shift" s17="Greater planar binding" s19=Wish}
:::block{minimal hl}

::row{br="~" title="Bonus Feats" singleBreaks info="‹feat/Dodge›~‹feat/Empower Spell›~‹feat/Great Fortitude›~‹feat/Improved Initiative›~‹feat/Lightning Reflexes›~‹feat/Power Attack›~‹feat/Skill Focus› (Knowledge &#91&planes&#93&)~‹feat/Weapon Focus›"}
:::elephant
‹SOURCE The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder›

‹feat/Dodge›, ‹feat/Empower Spell›, ‹feat/Great Fortitude›, ‹feat/Improved Initiative›, ‹feat/Lightning Reflexes›, @hll[rule/Powerful Maneuvers], ‹feat/Skill Focus› (Knowledge [planes]), ‹feat/Weapon Focus›

::ab[Bloodline Arcana]{icon=magic ability="Whenever you cast a spell that deals energy damage, you can change the type of damage to electricity. This also changes the spell's descriptors to match this energy type."}
### Bloodline Powers
Like a djinni, you have both natural power over air and several other genie-based abilities.

::ab[Electricity Ray (Sp)]{l=1 icon=zap standard="You can unleash an elemental ray, targeting any foe within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack. This ray deals electricity damage equal to 1d6 + ‹misc/half› of your sorcerer level." useMod=Charisma3}
::ab[Elemental Resistance (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def passive="You gain electricity ‹umr/resistance› 10." imp9="Your electricity resistance increases to 20."}
::ab[Whirlwind (Su)]{l=9 icon=magic ability="You gain the ability to turn into a 10-foot-high whirlwind once per day for 1 round per sorcerer level."}
::ab[Elemental Movement (Su)]{l=15 icon=power ability="You gain a fly speed of 60 feet with average maneuverability."}

::ab[Power of the Djinn (Su)]{l=20 icon=magic-def flavor="You gain the power of genies to grant wishes." ability="Once per day, you can cast ‹spell/limited wish› as a spell-like ability. Such wishes must begin with the words &quot&I wish,&quot& and cannot duplicate a wish you have granted within the past 24 hours. If you use this ability to duplicate a spell with a costly material component, you must provide that component." passive="You also become immune to electricity damage." ability2="You can use *plane shift* once per day to travel to or from the Plane of Air." order=ap2}

draconic.name: Draconic
sources: The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder
description: ## Draconic
‹SOURCE PRPG Core Rulebook/75›
At some point in your family's history, a dragon interbred with your bloodline, and now its ancient power flows through your veins.
::cskill{gain=per}

::ab[Bonus Spells by Sorcerer Level]{icon=learn s3="Mage armor" s5="Resist energy" s7=Fly s9=Fear s11="Spell resistance" s13="Form of the dragon I" s15="Form of the dragon II" s17="Form of the dragon III" s19=Wish}
:::block{minimal hl}

::row{br="~" title="Bonus Feats" singleBreaks info="‹feat/Blind-Fight›~‹feat/Great Fortitude›~‹feat/Improved Initiative›~‹feat/Power Attack›~‹feat/Quicken Spell›~‹feat/Skill Focus› (Fly)~Skill Focus (Knowledge &#91&arcana&#93&)~‹feat/Toughness›"}
:::elephant
‹SOURCE The Elephant in the Room: Feat Taxes in Pathfinder›

‹feat/Blind-Fight›, ‹feat/Great Fortitude›, ‹feat/Improved Initiative›, @hll[rule/Powerful Maneuvers], ‹feat/Quicken Spell›, ‹feat/Skill Focus› (Fly), Skill Focus (Knowledge [arcana]), ‹feat/Toughness›

::ab[Bloodline Arcana]{icon=boost ability="Whenever you cast a spell with an energy descriptor that matches your draconic bloodline's energy type, that spell deals +1 point of damage per die rolled."}
### Bloodline Powers

The power of dragons flows through you and manifests in a number of ways. At 1st level, you must select one of the chromatic or metallic dragon types. This choice cannot be changed. A number of your abilities grant resistances and deal damage based on your dragon type, as noted on the following table.

::ab[Claws (Su)]{l=1 icon=melee free="You can grow claws. ::h3[Expanded Bloodlines]{jl}
‹SOURCE Legacy of Dragons/4›

Chromatic and metallic dragons remain the most common dragons to impart their legacy onto other species. The bloodrager and sorcerer classes each include a draconic bloodline that assumes the character's lineage is somehow connected with the power of a chromatic or metallic dragon. Presented below are expanded options for the existing draconic bloodlines, increasing the selection of heritages to include the numerous new true dragons. Each of the draconic bloodlines below alters the bloodrager's or sorcerer's bloodline arcana.

@HL[Energy Types:] Several of these new draconic bloodline options include non-standard damage types. For the sake of game balance, many of the damage types available to the bloodlines below somewhat differ from those produced by the parent dragon. Specifically, force energy, negative energy, and sonic energy have been altered to different types of energy. In cases where a dragon's energy type is listed as physical damage (such as bludgeoning or piercing), use that damage type when determining your breath weapon damage. For the purpose of the dragon resistance bloodline power, you gain DR equal to half the energy resistance you would normally gain against all attacks of that specific damage type. A character with the power of wyrms bloodline power gains immunity to her bloodline's damage type. For all other purposes, such as archetypes, bloodline powers, and feats, treat that dragon's energy type as fire.
::h4[Esoteric Dragons]{jl}

Though many of the enigmatic esoteric dragons remain aloof or intentionally distant from mortal affairs, occult dragons are the most likely to imprint their bloodline onto humanoids. Often such draconic blood is the result of ongoing experimentation. Scions of other esoteric dragons are far more unusual; such bloodlines usually result from explorers traveling the realms where these distant dragons dwell and being exposed to some spectacular and ill-understood power.

::ab[Variant Bloodline Arcana]{icon=learn-magic ability="When selecting spells known, you can choose spells from the ‹main/spells_>psychic« class spell list›. The psychic spells you select must normally be unavailable to your class. You can know only a number of psychic spells equal to the highest level spell you can cast from your class spell list, based on your current class level. When you're casting these spells, they function as ‹rule/psychic magic› instead of arcane. You use thought and emotion components instead of verbal and somatic components when casting these spells."}

The blood of imperial dragons is well known throughout the lands of Tian Xia, where such dragons form a strong part of much of the continent's mythology. This is particularly true in Xa Hoi, where imperial dragons rule. Imperial dragons in other lands may vary in their interactions with humanoids, but universally accept the praise (and fear) of those around them. The interests of outer dragons take them across the cosmos. Strange devices or experimentation are most likely to lead to the addition of outer dragon blood into a world's ecosystem. The hidden blood of an outer dragon in a family's lineage is difficult to detect or stamp out. On Golarion, these dragons most commonly find themselves drawn to the fabled land of Numeria and its alien technology, though they usually refuse to share any of their insights with that nation's residents.

Born from the elemental planes or the Shadow Plane, primal dragons are infused with primeval power. These dragons traveled to the Material Plane in ages past, and many of their kind continue to spread their blood and magical influence among the humanoid races of the world. description: ## Dreamspun
‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/137›

Your family is a long line of dreamers, who dream not as ordinary mortals do but rather as those who reach through and touch the supernal realm of dreams and the farthest shores of night.
